text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you. It was a really fantastic
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because no one wanted to
mess up in such a big event, but the
other runners used slightly different
strategies than they had in the
past.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to factor that into our
strategy going forward. Let's talk about
it on our way home.
Starting with what
happened at the gate...

We discuss different adjustments to
include in her
calculations all the way
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, we're back already. That was fast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But since we've come up with so many
ideas, I'd
like to give some of them a try.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we still have some time
until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right. Thanks for helping with
this.

Biwa Hayahide and I start heading
toward the
training course, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race. She was
amazing. I want
to win harder than ever,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All I've been hearing about is how great she is or how she's unbeatable. It's so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They're all just saying that because they've never seen me run!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait! Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm not gonna lose to either of you!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: RAAAH! AAAAH!

Whenever one of them pulls ahead, the
other immediately pushes forward.
Neither of them
relents as their race
continues.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They both run so amazingly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is tenacious and persists at full
speed until the very end... And the
ferocity of Taishin's
pursuit is
unparalleled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are first-class competitors
in their
own right. They're incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I know I was the one who asked to
come
out here, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Can we try out our calculations another
time? If
they see me now, well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... You've been nothing but

accommodating today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wanted to discuss my future plans...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe I should take on the Classic
Triple Crown
tour as the next step of my
journey.

It consists of the Satsuki Sho, the
Japanese
Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

And, just like the Japanese Derby, each
one can
only be challenged once in a
racer's life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to perfect my winning equation so
I can be
the greatest of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Barring that, I at least want to be an
Umamusume like none other. Otherwise,
there's no way I can
ever hope to
compete with Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And in order to reach that goal, I'll
inevitably
need to confront Ticket and
Taishin head-on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Do I have your support in this endeavor?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thank you. I knew I could count
on you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the greatest
Umamusume of all time. One that
neither Ticket nor Taishin nor
anyone
else can beat.

Biwa Hayahide's words cement her
decision to enter the Satsuki Sho, the
first race of the Classic
Triple Crown
tour.
